full_judgment: 5. The suit was contested by the defendant No.1 filing written statement. In the written statement it was averred that the suit was not maintainable, the suit is hit under Section 42 of the Specific Relief Act and the plaintiff had filed a test suit having no real cause of action. The case of the defendant No.1, in short, is that before the CS record of right the suit land had gone into the water of the river and after 20 years the land was reformed-in-situ and as such under the provision of P.0.15 of 1972 and also under Section 86 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, the suit land has been vested to the government as khas land. The plaintiff has no right, title and interest into the suit land and the suit is liable to be dismissed with costs.
